sources.section: Version-specific upgrade notes > Upgrading to version 8.8 and higher
sources.observation: For this on-premises upgrade from 7.x+, the SECA modular input remains disabled after upgrade. Operators using AI triage must enable Send SH Metadata to SECA in Splunk Web Settings > Data inputs. If Platform 10.6+ is already installed, migration of missioncontrol.mc_incidents adds roughly five minutes per GB, with analyst queue/service interruptions. If deliberately shortening the migration by reducing findings/investigations retention, apply the approved policy at least 24 hours before upgrade, allow it to run and recheck collection size; do not describe shortening retention as mandatory for all upgrades. ES first and then Platform 10.6+ allows the migration to occur in background. Cloud upgrades are coordinated with Splunk Support.

sources.observation: For Cloud ES 8.5+, SOAR Cloud 8.5+ supports same-cloud AWS, Azure or GCP. Hybrid CA policy permits private or public CA for Cloud ES 8.8+ and only public CA for 8.2.x–8.7.x. IL5 hybrid pairing is unsupported. Keep Premier suite-specific table and standalone pairing table distinct.

findings.section: What is supported; Supported product areas; How to access; AI assistant features; Context limitations; Data sharing and use
findings.assessment: English natural-language Assistant is subject to the Azure OpenAI acceptable-use and content rules. It names AWS excluding GovCloud and GCP and names us0/us1/us2/us3/eu0/eu1/eu2/au0/jp0/sg0. Product table includes Agent Observability and Secure Application with underlying product differences. Log queries consume SVC quota. The guide describes essential use of inputs/outputs/grounding/usage data and separate organization-admin research sharing disabled by default. The features table describes resumable threads and a downloadable PDF; the context section limits access to the most recent interaction within 30 days. Preserve both descriptions unless Splunk clarifies the relationship.

findings.section: Realm to region equivalence; Available components per region or realm
findings.assessment: us0=AWS Virginia; us1=AWS Oregon; us2=Google Cloud Oregon; eu0=AWS Dublin; eu1=AWS Frankfurt; eu2=AWS London; au0=AWS Sydney; jp0=AWS Tokyo; sg0=AWS Singapore. us3 is missing from the region mapping, although the Assistant explicitly names it. Agent Observability component table narrows to us0/us1/eu0/au0/jp0. Secure Application has no Google Cloud region in the table. Database Monitoring US lists us2 but its Google Cloud regions cell says None.

findings.section: Availability; Use AI troubleshooting agent; Use AI remediation plan; How To Make RCA More Effective; Before running RCA
findings.assessment: Non-governmental realm, APM service/business-transaction-error and Kubernetes alert scope. Detector-triggered path explicitly requires standard metrics and excludes custom metrics. Later optimization guidance allows custom metrics to contribute when suitably dimensioned; it does not grant eligibility to custom-metric detectors. Manual RCA available, org automatic enablement via support. Remediation plans are currently Kubernetes-alert-only; operator executes suggested steps. RCA chat integration and log/entity-index permissions are documented. No general right to infer Assistant model routing, data retention or regulated approval for RCA.

findings.section: July 8, 2026, AI troubleshooting agent
findings.assessment: The specific July milestone adds root-cause identification for APM business transaction errors. The current guide supplies the broader currently documented workflow; avoid treating July 8 as release date of every RCA capability.

limits: No official mapping from us3 to a physical region in the service description, and no named RCA-specific model provider, residency or retention promise established in the reviewed RCA guide. These are affirmative boundaries an owner can report in a scoped assessment.
Existing canonical RCA requirements present a blanket custom-metric exclusion and omit the separate optimization guidance; current Assistant text omits the resumable-thread/context distinction.
